correctness.rationale: In any connected cactus E=N−1+c. In a bipartite cactus each cycle consumes at least one new vertex of each color and three new vertices overall in its block-cut tree; hence c≤min(p−1,q−1,⌊(p+q−1)/3⌋). Attaching four-cycles at two distinguished opposite-color vertices with x=max(0,2k−p), y=k−1−x realizes every bound simultaneously, then bridge-leaf additions span unused vertices. Boundary k=0 gives a star. Independent exhaustive subset maxima matched all 16 bipartition pairs p,q≤4; infinite proof does not rely on enumeration.
